progress.label: First-playable game foundation
progress.basis: Tracked gates: Evolved mechanics; party modes; reusable adventures; live dinosaur peril; source-driven NPC travel. Remaining: offensive combat, procedural adventures, graphical playtest sign-off.
progress.note: This measures the specified first-playable foundation, not unlimited future campaigns.

roadmap.label: Full approved Dinosaur Horror RPG delivery roadmap
roadmap.scope: Bounded, reviewable delivery scope across Evolved mechanics, game engine, adventure content, autonomy, AI, generation, security and QA. Not a claim that an infinite supply of stories can ever be exhausted.
roadmap.note: Only accepted source-backed gates earn points; partially implemented gates receive no credit until their whole acceptance requirement passes. Weights are planning choices, not automated estimates of code quantity.
